The '''Battle of ''Pondut''''' was a battle fought during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] at ''[[Pondut]]''.

==Prelude==
[[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]], who was the head of research and development of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy's]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], had recently developed [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defenders]] and delivered them to [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], despite his ''[[Research]]'' [[XQ6 Platform|platform]] being [[Attack on Research|attacked]] at the station and at the [[Battle of Vinzen Neela 5|transfer site]] at [[Vinzen Neela 5]] by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] raiders for the Emperor's personal inspection.

Soon Zaarin decided to focus on new research on Beam weapon systems to be installed on his TIE Fighters. However, his supplies and equipment were [[Raid on the Research convoy|attacked]] again by a Rebel strike force. During the battle [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wings]] were discovered to be using a new [[Warhead/Legends|Warhead]], after disabling one of the B-wings they discovered that the warhead was a [[Mag-pulse warhead/Legends|Mag pulse]] warhead, developed by [[Galactic Electronics]] in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]]. This was considered [[Treason/Legends|treason]] and Zaarin decided to seize the corporation's [[XQ2 Platform|Station]] ''[[Pondut]]'' and all assets and technology.

==The battle==
Zaarin first sent [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboats]] ''[[Tau]]'', one of which piloted by [[Imperial Ace]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]], to take care of the platform's [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]] ''Adam'', ''Charlie'' and ''Delta''. While the dogfighting began, quickly in the Gunboats favor, a [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|Stormtrooper transport]] ''[[GEC U47]]'' docked with a [[Class-A cargo container|container]] and attempted to flee the battle. But ''Maarek Stele'' intercepted and disabled the transport before it could escape. Realizing that their starfighters were losing, a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|Lambda-class T-4a shuttle]] ''[[Kalree]]'' containing VIPs launched from the platform attempting to escape, but the shuttle was also disabled by Stele. A [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] ''[[Lucky Day]]'' carrying an arms dealer also launched from the station to escape to hyperspace, only to be disabled by Stele as well. 3 minutes into the battle 3 [[Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport]]s [[Omega group (Gamma-class)|Omega]] arrived as the last of the Z-95s were destroyed. Stele also helped the Assault transports in disabling Platform ''Pondut'', which wasn't easy because the installation was well armed with multiple laser turrets.

When the station was disabled two [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wings]], 4 [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]], armed with Mag Pulse warheads, and a [[Cargo ferry]] ''[[Bujiboi]]'' arrived, but the A-wings and the ''Bujiboi'' became overwhelemed when [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Star Destroyer'']] [[Glory (Imperial-class)|''Glory'']] arrived, launching [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE Bombers]] destroyed the ''Buhjiboi'' and the 4 Y-wings were disabled in an attempt to acquire the warheads for themselves. Soon afterwards B-wings arrived to destroy the station, but they were all destroyed by Stele, while he made sure that the [[Utility Tug/Legends|Utility tugs]], [[U-4f91]], [[U-4f92]], [[U-4f93]], and [[U-4f94]] docked with the disabled Y-wings and brought them to the ''Glory''.

==Aftermath==
The capture of ''Pondut'' was considered by the Empire to be an example to anyone who was thinking of trading with their enemies, with the punishment being [[Death/Legends|death]]. This also, likely, put a strain on relations with the corporate sector as it was 'Neutral territory'.

Zaarin then went back to his research and soon his Beam weapon was completed and was loaded onto his starfighters. Palpatine assumed that Zaarin would serve the Empire well with these developments. Unfortunately Zaarin had other ideas. Meanwhile, Stele was then transferred to the [[Ottega system/Legends|Ottega system]] where [[Admiral Harkov's fleet]] had been discovered and [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Vader]] was soon to personally oversee the operation on his Star Destroyer [[Garrett (Star Destroyer)|''Garrett'']].

==Behind the scenes==
This battle takes place in the [[1994]] PC game ''Star Wars: TIE Fighter''. This is battle 6 combat 4. This article assumes all "Primary", "Secondary" and "Bonus" objectives are completed.
